name: Zarah
overview: Zarah, also known as Zerah or Zara, is identified in Scripture as a son of Judah and Tamar, highlighting his place within the Messianic lineage (Genesis 38:30; 1 Chronicles 2:4). The biblical record traces Zarah's descendants, noting the families arising from him, such as the Zarhites, and individuals like Zimri, Ethan, and Heman, emphasizing the continuity of Judah's line through Zarah (Numbers 26:20; 1 Chronicles 2:6). His presence in genealogies underscores God's providential preservation of the covenant people, as seen in Nehemiah where a descendant of Zarah serves in a position of responsibility (Nehemiah 11:24).
